Stated Claim / Post Context:
Supreme Court rejects GOP-backed Missouri map, preserving key seat for Democrats

The U.S. Supreme Court rejected a Republican attempt at redistricting congressional seats in Missouri - possibly giving Democrats a boost in their effort to win the House in the midterm elections.
